lines.say: blocks aromatase, the enzyme that makes estrogen
estradiol falls: 75% to 95% within days in women after menopause
treats hormone receptor-positive breast cancer after menopause
triggers ovulation: more live births than clomiphene in PCOS (off-label)
high estradiol can suppress LH and FSH, so it's used off-label in some infertile men
testosterone and semen measures improved in men (8 studies of its class; off-label)
high cholesterol more often than with tamoxifen (52.3% versus 28.6%)
bone thins: fractures 14.7% and osteoporosis 5.1%, more than with tamoxifen
harm to a fetus: miscarriages and birth defects reported
